script.title: 重生后我用系统改写全家命运
script.titleEn: Reborn to Rewrite My Family Fate
script.logline: 被假千金害到家破人亡的真千金重生归来，绑定命运改写系统，靠证据、布局和狠决心，把全家从前世死局里一一救回。
script.synopsis: 林晚月前世被接回豪门林家后，始终活在假千金乔安然的阴影里。父亲因一份伪造合同破产入狱，母亲被慢性下药精神崩溃，哥哥为保护她车祸残疾，而她自己则在认亲宴后的大火中被活活烧死。临死前，她才听见乔安然承认：所谓真假千金，只是林家二叔夺产计划里最温柔的一把刀。再睁眼，林晚月回到认亲宴前七天，并绑定“全家命运改写系统”。系统不能凭空复仇，只会在她做出关键选择时提示前世节点，奖励证据线索和短暂能力。林晚月不再渴望被爱，而是先救人、再清算。她截下父亲的陷阱合同，阻止哥哥车祸，逼出母亲被下药的真相，也让林家第一次看清乔安然的伪善。可随着调查深入，林晚月发现自己的身世另有隐情：当年换婴并非意外，母亲也并非完全不知情。最终，她在林家周年宴上设局反杀二叔与乔安然，却在系统结算时得知，所谓重生并不是天赐机会，而是前世母亲用生命为她换来的最后一次回档。

episodes.title: 重回认亲宴前夜
episodes.hook: 系统奖励的监控碎片揭开惊人关系：乔安然深夜进入林怀远书房，并喊他“爸”，暗示真假千金背后另有夺产阴谋。
episodes.summary: 大火吞没认亲宴后的林宅。林晚月被锁在杂物间，隔着火光听见乔安然轻笑：“真千金又怎样？林家很快就是我爸的了。”下一秒，房梁坠落。她猛地睁眼，眼中火光变成酒店水晶灯——手机日期显示，认亲宴前七天。淡金色字幕浮现：命运改写系统绑定，首个节点：林正廷签署致命合同，失败则林氏破产、父亲入狱。林晚月冲进会议室，正撞见父亲与二叔林怀远准备签约。她夺过合同，所有人震惊。乔安然红着眼上前：“姐姐，你是不是怕爸爸把钱分给我？”林正廷沉下脸，斥她胡闹。前世父亲戴着手铐的画面刺入脑海，林晚月强迫自己冷静，翻到骑缝章处，指出章印错位半毫米，附件页纸张批次不同。律师不耐烦，却被她逼着当场核验电子备案。几分钟后，结果弹出：核心担保附件被替换，金额多出三十亿。会议室死寂。林怀远笑意微僵，乔安然攥紧裙摆。林正廷第一次认真看向这个刚接回来的女儿。系统提示：节点改写成功，奖励监控碎片。画面里，深夜的林怀远书房门开，乔安然低声喊：“爸，林晚月已经开始怀疑了。”。本集按“铺垫、压迫、转折、爆发、余韵”推进：铺垫人物当下目标，压迫来自极寒环境和道德勒索，转折来自一个被忽略的细节，爆发不是喊叫而是主角做出反常选择，余韵落在新的危机。人物关系上，表层冲突是立场对抗，隐藏关系是双方都掌握对方不知道的信息，因此台词必须克制、短促、有潜台词。

episodes.scriptText: 本集开场不解释设定，直接落在“系统奖励的监控碎片揭开惊人关系：乔安然深夜进入林怀远书房，并喊他“爸”，暗示真假千金背后另有夺产阴谋。”这个瞬间，让观众先感到人物被逼到选择边缘。宁晚的当下目标不是赢得争吵，而是在有限时间内判断谁可信、什么信息被隐藏、自己是否要承担更大的代价。场面调度围绕冰封街区、堡垒暖光和系统警告展开，主体始终被压在空间边缘，前景遮挡和背景景深共同制造窥视感与窒息感。中段通过沉默、视线闪避、手指收紧和短促呼吸替代直白解释，让冲突从外部压力转为人物内心的权衡。转折处必须提前埋下一个可被观众回想起来的细节，再让主角用反常选择改变权力关系。结尾停在“系统奖励的监控碎片揭开惊人关系：乔安然深夜进入林怀远书房，并喊他“爸”，暗示真假千金背后另有夺产阴谋。”，只释放一个新的危险或真相，不解释答案，让观众带着问题进入下一集。

shots.aiPromptEn: English prompt: vertical 9:16 cinematic AI drama with consistent character design, suitable for image-to-video and text-to-video production. Lin Wanyue is a young elegant woman in her early twenties, long black hair, pale face, sharp expressive eyes; her emotion evolves from terrified survivor to calm avenger. Open inside the burning Lin mansion after a recognition banquet: charred doorframe and twisted chains dominate the foreground, Lin Wanyue sits trapped in a storage room with soot and blood on her face, flames pouring through the door crack and window lattice. In the background, red banquet ribbons, a shattered champagne tower and a collapsed flower wall burn. Qiao Anran appears half-hidden beyond the fire in a pale dress, smiling softly, dropping a key into the flames. Use a low-angle close-up from Lin Wanyue’s trembling fingers to her firelit eyes, then rack focus through the door crack to Qiao Anran’s blurred smile; a falling beam shadow crushes the frame and cuts to black. Match cut to a hotel suite: fire reflections become warm white crystal chandelier light in her pupils. She wakes, checks her unburned neck and wrists, grabs the phone showing seven days before the banquet. Pale golden system text floats between her and the mirror: fate rewrite system bound, first node: Lin Zhengting signs a deadly contract, failure means Lin Group bankruptcy and father imprisoned. She suppresses fear, hardens her gaze, throws on a coat and runs out. Cut to the Lin hotel conference room: long table, executives and lawyers, cold business lighting. Lin Zhengting is about to sign, Lin Huaiyuan sits at his right with a controlled smile, Qiao Anran stands behind him pretending to be gentle and wronged. Extreme close-up of the pen tip on the signature line, then handheld tracking as Lin Wanyue bursts in against backlight, presses down the contract and snatches it away. Show tense reaction shots: father angry, Qiao Anran teary, Lin Huaiyuan’s smile stiffening. Final sequence: the contract lies open on the table, macro shots of a half-millimeter misaligned seam seal, different paper fibers on the attachment pages, electronic filing numbers loading on a projected screen. The lawyer turns pale as the pop-up reveals the core guarantee attachment was replaced and the guarantee amount increased by three billion. The room falls silent; Lin Zhengting looks at his daughter seriously for the first time, Lin Huaiyuan hides panic, Qiao Anran clenches her skirt until her knuckles whiten. A cold system notification announces success, then overlay a black-and-white surveillance fragment with timecode and static: late-night study door opening, Qiao Anran checks the corridor, enters the shadows and whispers to Lin Huaiyuan, calling him Dad. Emphasize realistic acting, micro-expressions, suspenseful pacing, layered spatial depth, shallow depth of field, orange-red fire contrast, warm hotel lighting, cold blue meeting-room tension, black-and-white noisy CCTV texture, with audible flames, breaking wood, glass bursts, phone vibration, air conditioner hum, paper rustle, mouse clicks and electronic static.

shots.aiPromptEn: English prompt: vertical 9:16 cinematic AI drama with consistent character design, suitable for image-to-video and text-to-video production. Lin Wanyue is a young elegant woman in her early twenties, long black hair, pale face, sharp expressive eyes; her emotion evolves from terrified survivor to calm avenger. Open inside the burning Lin mansion after a recognition banquet: charred doorframe and twisted chains dominate the foreground, Lin Wanyue sits trapped in a storage room with soot and blood on her face, flames pouring through the door crack and window lattice. In the background, red banquet ribbons, a shattered champagne tower and a collapsed flower wall burn. Qiao Anran appears half-hidden beyond the fire in a pale dress, smiling softly, dropping a key into the flames. Use a low-angle close-up from Lin Wanyue’s trembling fingers to her firelit eyes, then rack focus through the door crack to Qiao Anran’s blurred smile; a falling beam shadow crushes the frame and cuts to black. Match cut to a hotel suite: fire reflections become warm white crystal chandelier light in her pupils. She wakes, checks her unburned neck and wrists, grabs the phone showing seven days before the banquet. Pale golden system text floats between her and the mirror: fate rewrite system bound, first node: Lin Zhengting signs a deadly contract, failure means Lin Group bankruptcy and father imprisoned. She suppresses fear, hardens her gaze, throws on a coat and runs out. Cut to the Lin hotel conference room: long table, executives and lawyers, cold business lighting. Lin Zhengting is about to sign, Lin Huaiyuan sits at his right with a controlled smile, Qiao Anran stands behind him pretending to be gentle and wronged. Extreme close-up of the pen tip on the signature line, then handheld tracking as Lin Wanyue bursts in against backlight, presses down the contract and snatches it away. Show tense reaction shots: father angry, Qiao Anran teary, Lin Huaiyuan’s smile stiffening. Final sequence: the contract lies open on the table, macro shots of a half-millimeter misaligned seam seal, different paper fibers on the attachment pages, electronic filing numbers loading on a projected screen. The lawyer turns pale as the pop-up reveals the core guarantee attachment was replaced and the guarantee amount increased by three billion. The room falls silent; Lin Zhengting looks at his daughter seriously for the first time, Lin Huaiyuan hides panic, Qiao Anran clenches her skirt until her knuckles whiten. A cold system notification announces success, then overlay a black-and-white surveillance fragment with timecode and static: late-night study door opening, Qiao Anran checks the corridor, enters the shadows and whispers to Lin Huaiyuan, calling him Dad. Emphasize realistic acting, micro-expressions, suspenseful pacing, layered spatial depth, shallow depth of field, orange-red fire contrast, warm hotel lighting, cold blue meeting-room tension, black-and-white noisy CCTV texture, with audible flames, breaking wood, glass bursts, phone vibration, air conditioner hum, paper rustle, mouse clicks and electronic static.

shots.camera: 镜头语言：先给钢笔尖压在签字栏上的特写，笔尖刚要划下时，门声响起，快速横移到林晚月冲入；中景手持感跟随她穿过长桌侧边，制造失控感。她夺合同瞬间切近景，合同纸张掠过镜头，随后反打林正廷沉下的脸与乔安然泛红的眼眶。
shots.action: 人物动作：林晚月冲到父亲身边，一把按住合同，另一只手夺过整份文件，身体微微发抖但站得很稳。林正廷眉头紧锁，钢笔悬在半空；林怀远笑容停在脸上，手指轻敲桌面掩饰不悦。乔安然立刻上前半步，眼眶含泪，手轻轻扶住林正廷椅背，把自己放在受委屈的位置。
shots.dialogue: 乔安然哽咽：“姐姐，你是不是怕爸爸把钱分给我？”林正廷压着火：“晚月，放下，别在外人面前胡闹。”林晚月看着父亲：“这不是钱，是你的命。”
shots.sound: 会议室空调低鸣、钢笔笔帽轻碰桌面的细响、合同纸张被夺走的哗啦声；众人压低的吸气与窃窃私语浮起，林晚月说最后一句时背景声短暂抽空。
shots.emotion: 情绪与戏剧目的：制造亲情误解与信任危机，乔安然借势塑造林晚月贪婪失控，林晚月必须在全场敌意中争取验证时间。

shots.visual: 林家一楼会客厅，冷白吊灯压低空间，长桌上被截下的合同摊开，纸页边角被林晚月按住。林砚舟站在桌另一端，西装笔挺、半张脸落在阴影里；乔安然靠近沈清禾，眼眶泛红，像受惊一样抓着沈清禾袖口。背景里佣人停在门边，不敢出声，空气像结冰。
shots.camera: 中远景建立三角站位，林晚月在前景左侧、林砚舟在纵深中心、乔安然和沈清禾在右后方。镜头缓慢横移，先掠过合同陷阱条款，再推到林砚舟审视的眼神，最后虚焦切到乔安然含泪的脸，形成真假千金对峙构图。
shots.action: 林晚月指尖压着合同，指节发白却不解释；林砚舟翻过一页，眼皮微抬，像在判断她到底知道多少；乔安然轻轻抽泣，低头时嘴角一瞬收紧，又立刻贴近沈清禾。沈清禾呼吸不稳，揉着太阳穴，对林晚月的眼神多了一层防备。
shots.dialogue: 乔安然低声说：妈，我不是怕她回来……我是怕这个家再也不像家。林砚舟看向林晚月：你最好想清楚，谁告诉你的。林晚月只回：现在签，会出事。
shots.sound: 纸张被翻动的干涩声，吊灯轻微电流声，乔安然压抑的啜泣，远处钟摆声被低频音效放大。
shots.emotion: 戏剧目的：升级家庭不信任，把林晚月推到孤立位置；林砚舟开始怀疑她的消息来源，乔安然借示弱把矛盾从合同转移到争宠与抢夺家产。

shots.aiPromptEn: English prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical cinematic AI drama / AI comic-video sequence with consistent character design and a cold luxury suspense tone. Lin Wanyue is a young restrained woman with slightly messy long hair, pale elegant clothing, determined eyes; Lin Yanzhou is tall, cold, in a dark tailored suit, often half-lit by shadow; Qiao Anran appears fragile and tearful in a refined dress, but with hidden malice; Shen Qinghe is an elegant wealthy mother, flushed and unstable due to medication. Start in the Lin family reception room under low cold-white chandeliers: the intercepted contract lies open on a long table, Wanyue presses the pages with white knuckles, Yanzhou watches from the opposite end, Anran clings to Qinghe’s sleeve while servants freeze by the doorway. Use a slow lateral medium-wide move across the contract clauses, then push to Yanzhou’s suspicious eyes and rack focus to Anran’s tearful face. Cut to a night corridor: a red system countdown reflects in Wanyue’s pupils, three hours before Yanzhou’s car crash. Handheld follow her rushing downstairs into a cold-blue underground garage; switch to high surveillance angle with timestamp, showing her apparently tailing Yanzhou near a black sedan. In the stairwell, mix warm and cold light as medicated Qinghe loses control; Anran rushes in and stages a false perspective of Wanyue pushing her mother, while guards and servants close in. Wanyue ignores the accusation and follows the countdown to the garage blind spot. Low under-car close-ups show her oil-stained, bleeding hands searching the backup wiring; flash fragments reveal the hidden controller, not the brake pads. Yanzhou starts the car, brake warning lights flash red, headlights rush toward a concrete pillar. Wanyue pulls the main breaker, instant blackout, tire screech, the car stops inches from her. End in a late-night study: overhead static shot of dashcam footage showing Anran’s driver touching the car, Qinghe’s toxicology report, and an eighteen-year-old DNA test hidden in the file; Yanzhou steps half a pace in front of Wanyue for the first time. Emphasize realistic acting, layered foreground-midground-background depth, cold blue versus alarm red lighting, detailed skin texture, fabric folds, paper fibers, oily reflections, wet concrete floor, tense environmental sound, surveillance distortion, handheld urgency, low-angle impact, and a final silent evidence reveal.

shots.visual: 夜色压进走廊，林晚月独自站在二楼拐角，手机屏幕突然映出红色系统倒计时：距离林砚舟车祸，还剩三小时。她脸上的血色被红光抽走。画面切入地下车库监控视角，冷蓝灯一排排延伸，林砚舟的背影走向黑色轿车，林晚月从柱后追来，监控画面右上角时间码跳动，构成尾随证据。
shots.camera: 从林晚月瞳孔特写开始，红色倒计时反射在眼中；急切手持跟拍她下楼，步伐不稳但目标明确。进入车库后切为固定高位监控视角，广角畸变强化她尾随林砚舟的误会；再切近景捕捉她看到监控摄像头时短暂僵住。
shots.action: 林晚月握紧手机，呼吸猛然断了一拍，随即提裙奔跑；她在车库入口停半秒，看到监控红点闪烁，眼神明白自己已经被拍下，却仍继续追。林砚舟没有回头，只按下车钥匙，车灯亮起。
shots.dialogue: 系统提示音冰冷：倒计时启动。林晚月压着喘息低声：这次不能再晚。林砚舟背对她说：别再跟着我。
shots.sound: 手机警报短促刺耳，楼梯急促脚步声，地下车库空旷回响，车锁解开的滴声，监控电流噪点与心跳低频叠加。
shots.emotion: 戏剧目的：明确车祸倒计时与时间压力，同时制造对林晚月极不利的监控证据；观众知道她在救人，剧中人物却会把她看成尾随者。

shots.visual: 楼梯间冷暖光交界，沈清禾扶着扶手站在台阶上方，脸色潮红、瞳孔发散，药性发作让她情绪失控。林晚月从下方返回取车库盲区路线图时被拦住。乔安然从侧门冲入，裙摆凌乱，故意撞向两人之间，画面瞬间形成沈清禾向后踉跄、林晚月伸手的错位假象。佣人和保镖从楼梯口涌出，把林晚月围在中心。
shots.camera: 楼梯下方仰拍沈清禾，压迫感强；乔安然冲入时用快速横移跟随，制造视觉混乱。关键一刻切侧逆光定格式构图：林晚月的手悬在半空，沈清禾后仰，乔安然尖叫在前景，观众能看到林晚月其实没有碰到她，但围观者视角被遮挡。随后环绕半圈拍保镖收紧包围。
shots.action: 沈清禾指着林晚月，手指颤抖，声音发虚却尖利；林晚月本能伸手想扶，立刻意识到陷阱，手僵在半空。乔安然扑到沈清禾身边，眼泪来得极快，抬头看林晚月时闪过挑衅。林晚月没有辩解，只低头看手机倒计时，瞳孔收紧，转身冲向车库盲区。
shots.dialogue: 沈清禾失控质问：你回来，就是要毁了我们吗？乔安然尖叫：别碰妈妈！你为什么要推她！林晚月咬字很轻：让开。

shots.aiPromptEn: English prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical cinematic AI drama / AI comic-video sequence with consistent character design and a cold luxury suspense tone. Lin Wanyue is a young restrained woman with slightly messy long hair, pale elegant clothing, determined eyes; Lin Yanzhou is tall, cold, in a dark tailored suit, often half-lit by shadow; Qiao Anran appears fragile and tearful in a refined dress, but with hidden malice; Shen Qinghe is an elegant wealthy mother, flushed and unstable due to medication. Start in the Lin family reception room under low cold-white chandeliers: the intercepted contract lies open on a long table, Wanyue presses the pages with white knuckles, Yanzhou watches from the opposite end, Anran clings to Qinghe’s sleeve while servants freeze by the doorway. Use a slow lateral medium-wide move across the contract clauses, then push to Yanzhou’s suspicious eyes and rack focus to Anran’s tearful face. Cut to a night corridor: a red system countdown reflects in Wanyue’s pupils, three hours before Yanzhou’s car crash. Handheld follow her rushing downstairs into a cold-blue underground garage; switch to high surveillance angle with timestamp, showing her apparently tailing Yanzhou near a black sedan. In the stairwell, mix warm and cold light as medicated Qinghe loses control; Anran rushes in and stages a false perspective of Wanyue pushing her mother, while guards and servants close in. Wanyue ignores the accusation and follows the countdown to the garage blind spot. Low under-car close-ups show her oil-stained, bleeding hands searching the backup wiring; flash fragments reveal the hidden controller, not the brake pads. Yanzhou starts the car, brake warning lights flash red, headlights rush toward a concrete pillar. Wanyue pulls the main breaker, instant blackout, tire screech, the car stops inches from her. End in a late-night study: overhead static shot of dashcam footage showing Anran’s driver touching the car, Qinghe’s toxicology report, and an eighteen-year-old DNA test hidden in the file; Yanzhou steps half a pace in front of Wanyue for the first time. Emphasize realistic acting, layered foreground-midground-background depth, cold blue versus alarm red lighting, detailed skin texture, fabric folds, paper fibers, oily reflections, wet concrete floor, tense environmental sound, surveillance distortion, handheld urgency, low-angle impact, and a final silent evidence reveal.

shots.action: 林晚月咬住袖口，用力拔线，手背被金属划破也不松；林砚舟猛踩刹车，肩颈绷紧，第一次真正失控。车停后，他下车看见她满手血污，原本质问的话卡住。书房里，他把行车记录仪推到众人面前，站到林晚月前方半步；林晚月翻开药检报告夹层，看到DNA鉴定时呼吸停住，林砚舟的眼神也沉下去。
shots.dialogue: 林砚舟低声：碰过车的人，不是她。林晚月看着鉴定书：十八年前……她知道。林砚舟压住情绪：从现在开始，先别信任何人。

aiManhuaDrama.scriptText: 本集开场不解释设定，直接落在“林砚舟开始相信林晚月，并与她拿到沈清禾药检报告；可报告夹层中的十八年前DNA鉴定显示，沈清禾早已接触过换婴真相，母亲的秘密比他们想象得更深。”这个瞬间，让观众先感到人物被逼到选择边缘。宁晚的当下目标不是赢得争吵，而是在有限时间内判断谁可信、什么信息被隐藏、自己是否要承担更大的代价。场面调度围绕冰封街区、堡垒暖光和系统警告展开，主体始终被压在空间边缘，前景遮挡和背景景深共同制造窥视感与窒息感。中段通过沉默、视线闪避、手指收紧和短促呼吸替代直白解释，让冲突从外部压力转为人物内心的权衡。转折处必须提前埋下一个可被观众回想起来的细节，再让主角用反常选择改变权力关系。结尾停在“林砚舟开始相信林晚月，并与她拿到沈清禾药检报告；可报告夹层中的十八年前DNA鉴定显示，沈清禾早已接触过换婴真相，母亲的秘密比他们想象得更深。”，只释放一个新的危险或真相，不解释答案，让观众带着问题进入下一集。

episodes.title: 全家命运改写完成
episodes.hook: 系统宣布全家命运改写完成，却揭开终极反转：重生并非天赐外挂，而是前世沈清禾用生命和玉坠为林晚月换来的最后一次机会。
episodes.summary: 林氏周年宴金光璀璨，林怀远却在董事与媒体面前提前发难，甩出林正廷涉嫌违规交易的材料，逼董事会临场改选。乔安然红着眼站到镜头前，控诉自己被林晚月霸凌、被林家抛弃，舆论瞬间倒向她。林正廷脸色惨白，沈清禾指尖发抖，所有人都看向林晚月。她却没有退，直接打开大屏：“今晚，谁都别想再用体面遮丑。”第一段录音，是林怀远指使秘书替换合同；第二条转账链，连到制造林砚舟车祸的空壳公司；第三份病历，证明沈清禾多年被私人医生慢性下药。林怀远反咬她伪造证据，乔安然扑上前哭喊。沈清禾却摘下玉坠，当众承认当年她察觉换婴，却被林怀远用婴儿安全威胁，被药物控制到无人相信。玉坠里最后一段录音响起：林怀远亲口承认乔安然是他的私生女，抱错从一开始就是夺产局。警笛逼近，林怀远被带走，乔安然崩溃冲向林晚月，被林砚舟拦下。林正廷终于低头道歉，沈清禾抱住晚月泣不成声。系统金字浮现：全家命运改写完成。可下一秒，结算画面碎裂，前世火场中，沈清禾跪在她焦黑尸身旁握碎玉坠，低声说：“用我的命，换她重来一次。”林晚月泪水落下，才懂系统不是奖励，是母亲迟来的爱。本集按“铺垫、压迫、转折、爆发、余韵”推进：铺垫人物当下目标，压迫来自极寒环境和道德勒索，转折来自一个被忽略的细节，爆发不是喊叫而是主角做出反常选择，余韵落在新的危机。人物关系上，表层冲突是立场对抗，隐藏关系是双方都掌握对方不知道的信息，因此台词必须克制、短促、有潜台词。

Set inside the Lin family anniversary banquet hall: low golden chandeliers, champagne tower, press light boards, whispering directors, a main table, reflective gold-and-white luxury that feels suffocating. Lin Huaiyuan in a dark suit stands at the front of the stage and slams documents onto the podium; behind him, a giant screen shows an emergency board proposal. Lin Zhengting sits pale at the main table, Shen Qinghe in a subdued qipao trembles while clutching a napkin and jade pendant, Qiao Anran in a white dress cries deliberately into reporters’ cameras, and Lin Wanyue in a black formal dress stands in the rear shadows, isolated but steady. Start with a wide banquet establishing shot, slowly push toward the stage, cut to a compressed telephoto media angle with Qiao’s tearful eyes in the foreground and Wanyue blurred behind, then a low angle of directors raising hands. Lights drop; cold white screen light frames Wanyue as she walks through the crowd, shoulder-follow camera, connects her phone, revealing audio waveforms, transaction chains, shell company names, and private medical records. Insert sharp close-ups of evidence, Huaiyuan’s shrinking pupils, Lin Yanzhou guarding the stairs. Qiao rushes forward crying and is blocked by Yanzhou. Shen Qinghe rises, removes the jade pendant, opens the hidden recorder, and exposes the truth: Qiao is Huaiyuan’s illegitimate daughter and the baby swap was planned for inheritance. Police sirens grow louder, red-blue lights cut into the golden hall, Huaiyuan is arrested, Qiao collapses, the father apologizes, the mother embraces Wanyue.
